page_title: CAG 1-4 ROM | Cagliari v AS Roma 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.

90+4' Riccardo Pagano (AS Roma) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
90+2' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' 1 - 4 Goal! Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Rui Patricio.
86' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
86' The Cagliari players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
86' Referee Simone Sozza makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Cagliari. Let’s see what happens!
86' Surely that's handball by one of the AS Roma players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
85' The resulting corner from Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) is cleared by the defence.

85' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Cagliari. Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
83' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma).
81' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
80' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
79' Jose Mourinho has decided to make a change. Zeki Celik (AS Roma) replaces Leandro Paredes.
79' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
76' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post.
74' Gaetano Oristanio goes off the pitch and Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) comes on.
73' Celebrations are cut short for Cagliari as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
73' Wait! Referee Simone Sozza has indicated he is going to review the Cagliari goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

72' The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Matteo Prati (Cagliari) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the top right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Rui Patricio, so the score changes to 1:4.
69' Jose Mourinho decides to make a substitution. Rick Karsdorp will be replaced by Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma).
69' Jose Mourinho has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Riccardo Pagano (AS Roma) replacing Houssem Aouar.
68' Substitution. Andrea Petagna will be replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
68' Adam Obert will be replaced by Alberto Dossena (Cagliari).
68' A short pass finds Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
67' The resulting free kick from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
66' Adam Obert (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Simone Sozza saw the whole situation.
64' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
61' Adam Obert (Cagliari) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

59' 0 - 4 Goal! Leandro Paredes produces a great pass that finds Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 0:4.
57' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
51' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and AS Roma players have a reason to celebrate!
51' The AS Roma players joy may have been justified, because referee Simone Sozza is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
51' Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) has a goal ruled out for offside!
48' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) sends a long ball in, but Rui Patricio comfortably gathers the ball.
47' A precise low pass is received by Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
46' Claudio Ranieri makes a half-time substitution. Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) comes on in place of Pantelis Chatzidiakos.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Although Jose Mourinho (AS Roma) is just on the bench, Simone Sozza has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
41' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
40' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Andrea Belotti replaces him.
39' The substitution has been made. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) has replaced Ibrahim Sulemana.
39' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
34' The corner is swung in but AS Roma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
32' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.

30' Chance! Nahitan Nandez sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
26' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

26' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away. The ball is out of play and Cagliari manage to earn a corner.
21' Referee Simone Sozza signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the AS Roma players have a reason to celebrate!
21' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The AS Roma players aren’t happy.
20' 0 - 2 Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and slams the ball inside the left post. What a wonderful strike!

19' 0 - 1 Goal! Leonardo Spinazzola plays in Houssem Aouar (AS Roma), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 0:1.
14' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) has tested the patience of referee Simone Sozza and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
11' It must be a yellow card. It is. Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
10' Cagliari take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

10' The referee blows his whistle, Cagliari are awarded a corner kick. Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the bottom left corner of the goal. Rui Patricio displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
7' A quickly taken corner by AS Roma.
6' AS Roma are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Cagliari will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Simone Sozza.
Show lineups In the details of this match, you can glance at the lineups while the game is about to begin.
